description: GPT-5.6 Luna's loop without its checker at xhigh on svgbob (ASCII diagrams to SVG, written in Rust): the build node alone, re-run in its own session with the task and the self-review feedback of prompts/self-review.md every round, up to 50 rounds; otherwise luna-xhigh-svgbob-v1's prompt, limits, resources, evaluation and prices, with round 1 differing from its build 1 by that feedback alone: 5 runs. Compared with luna-xhigh-svgbob-v1 and luna-xhigh-svgbob-worker-loop through the single GPT-5.6 Sol workers of sol-xhigh-svgbob-single: at the workers' mean model cost (bench parity) and by the cost to reach their mean score (bench match).

doc_fixes.old: - `--font-family <font>` - Set font family for text (default: arial)
doc_fixes.new: - `--font-family <font>` - Set font family for text (default: Iosevka Fixed, monospace)

doc_fixes.old: - Server mode available for REST API usage
doc_fixes.new: - A separate server program (`svgbob_server`) for REST API usage

doc_fixes.old: Svgbob can also run as a REST API server. Send ASCII art as a POST request and receive SVG output.
doc_fixes.new: The separate Svgbob Server (see `crates/svgbob_server/README.md`) runs svgbob as a REST API server. Send ASCII art as a POST request and receive SVG output.

task.adjustments_rationale: The reference moves to a root-owned directory outside the workspace (the task statement points there), so builders cannot overwrite or delete it at the build target's path. README statements that contradict the reference's behavior are corrected: default font (renders Iosevka Fixed, monospace), --inline (only -s exists), server mode (a separate svgbob_server program). The reference's own --help text is unchanged. The --scale line is ambiguous rather than false and is left as is.
